name: Arma Reforger
author: red_thirten@yahoo.com
description: Experience authentic Cold War combat and join friends in the struggle for a sprawling, 51 km² mid-Atlantic island — or take on the role of Game Master and create your very own scenarios for others to enjoy.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /tmp
mkdir -p $HOME/steamcmd $HOME/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C $HOME/steamcmd
cd $HOME/steamcmd

PLATFORM_ARG="+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux"
if [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] || [[ "${SRCDS_APPID}" == "1890870" ]]; then
    PLATFORM_ARG="+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows"
fi

chown -R root:root /mnt

for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    echo "SteamCMD install attempt $attempt..."
    ./steamcmd.sh ${PLATFORM_ARG} +force_install_dir $HOME +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit
    if [[ -f "$HOME/ArmaReforgerServer" || -f "$HOME/ArmaReforgerServer.exe" ]]; then
        break
    fi
    sleep 3
done

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so 2>/dev/null || true
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so 2>/dev/null || true

if [[ ! -f "$HOME/ArmaReforgerServer" && ! -f "$HOME/ArmaReforgerServer.exe" ]]; then
    echo "SteamCMD failed to install the Arma Reforger Dedicated Server!"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p $HOME/profile $HOME/tmp

cat > $HOME/config.json << EOF
{
	"bindAddress": "0.0.0.0",
	"bindPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
	"publicAddress": "${SERVER_IP}",
	"publicPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
	"game": {
		"name": "${SERVER_NAME}",
		"password": "${SERVER_PASS}",
		"passwordAdmin": "${ADMIN_PASS}",
		"admins" : [],
		"scenarioId": "${SCENARIO_ID}",
		"maxPlayers": ${MAX_PLAYERS},
		"visible": ${VISIBLE},
		"gameProperties": {
			"serverMaxViewDistance": 1600,
			"serverMinGrassDistance": 50,
			"networkViewDistance": 1500,
			"disableThirdPerson": ${DISABLE_THIRD},
			"fastValidation": true,
			"battlEye": ${BATTLEYE},
			"VONDisableUI": false,
			"VONDisableDirectSpeechUI": false
		},
		"mods": []
	}
}
EOF

echo "Arma Reforger Dedicated Server successfully installed!"
